clusters.headline: Supreme Court Overturns Former PM Han Conviction And Acquits Yoon
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court ordered a retrial for former Prime Minister Han regarding his alleged involvement in a martial law attempt.
Judges finalized the acquittal of former President Yoon regarding charges of perjury.

clusters.headline: Seoul Stocks Open Higher Following Week Of Market Fluctuations
aiSummaryBullets: The Korea Composite Stock Price Index rose by 0.23 percent to 4,722.28 in early Friday trading.
Market participants engaged in bargain hunting to offset losses experienced during a week of significant price instability.

clusters.headline: North Korean Troops Cross Inter-Korean Border Multiple Times
aiSummaryBullets: North Korean soldiers reportedly crossed the Military Demarcation Line approximately 40 times between October and November.
The data provided by a South Korean lawmaker indicates 30 border violations occurred in October and 10 in November.

clusters.headline: South Korean Coast Guard Repatriates North Korean Fishing Vessel
aiSummaryBullets: South Korean authorities repatriated a North Korean fishing boat following maritime operations.
One crew member from the vessel declined the return and opted to stay in South Korea.

clusters.headline: Hyundai Unveils Mercury Electric Concept At Guangzhou Auto Show
aiSummaryBullets: Hyundai Motor Co. debuted an all-electric compact SUV concept car at the Guangzhou International Automobile Exhibition.
The vehicle, currently identified as the Mercury Concept, was presented on Friday at the event running until early December.

clusters.headline: Police Search Home Of Late Exam Top Scorer In AI Cheating Probe
aiSummaryBullets: Police conducted a search of the residence of a late candidate who achieved a perfect score on the law school entrance exam.
The ongoing investigation into the use of artificial intelligence for academic misconduct follows the resignation of the education minister.

clusters.headline: Persib Bandung Beats FC Seoul 3-1, Securing Group E ACL 2 Top Spot
aiSummaryBullets: Persib Bandung defeated FC Seoul 3-1 to finalize their standing as winners of Group E in the AFC Champions League 2.
Luka Menalo contributed significantly to the victory, while teammates Mariano Peralta and Danijel Loncar praised the team's performance.

clusters.headline: President Lee Jae Myung Approval Rating Increases To 41 Percent
aiSummaryBullets: President Lee Jae Myung's approval rating reached 41 percent in the latest weekly poll.
The figure represents a one percentage point increase compared to the previous survey results.

clusters.headline: Kim Jong-un Calls For Loyalty From Workers' Party Cell Secretaries
aiSummaryBullets: Kim Jong-un addressed participants at the Seventh Conference of Cell Secretaries of the Workers' Party of Korea.
The North Korean leader emphasized the importance of maintaining party discipline and securing unwavering loyalty among grassroots members.

clusters.headline: Police Raid South Korean Justice Ministry Over Records Leak Claims
aiSummaryBullets: Law enforcement officers conducted raids on the Ministry of Justice and multiple prosecution offices.
The search is part of an investigation into the potential unauthorized disclosure of investigative files.

clusters.headline: South Korea Selected As Co-Chair For Upcoming ASEAN+3 Finance Talks
aiSummaryBullets: South Korea is set to co-chair the upcoming ASEAN+3 Finance and Central Bank Deputies' Meeting.
The meetings are scheduled to take place in Singapore during April and in Seoul later in November.

clusters.headline: President Lee Jae Myung Addresses Domestic Policy and North Korea
aiSummaryBullets: President Lee Jae Myung urged a rapid increase in public housing supply to stabilize the local market.
The administration confirmed that North Korea will remain classified as an enemy in the upcoming defense white paper.

clusters.headline: Bank Of Korea Raises Key Interest Rate To 3.25 Percent Amid Boom
aiSummaryBullets: The Bank of Korea increased the key interest rate by 25 basis points to 3.25 percent to address persistent inflation.
Economic growth forecasts for 2027 were revised upward to 4.1 percent, driven by a surge in the semiconductor industry.

clusters.headline: Singer Mark From NCT Announces Upcoming Solo Studio Album Windmill
aiSummaryBullets: The former NCT member Mark will release his new studio album titled Windmill next month.
The upcoming album includes the lead single What’s Your Dream? Don’t Have One and previously released B-sides.

clusters.headline: South Korean Banks Report Net Profit Increase Through September
aiSummaryBullets: South Korean banks reached a combined net profit of 21.5 trillion won in the first nine months of the year.
The total net profit reflects a 2.1 percent increase compared to the same period in the previous year.

clusters.headline: Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il Addresses Volatile South Korea Market
aiSummaryBullets: Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il stated that the government has prepared contingency measures beyond existing stock market stabilization funds.
The KOSPI index experienced a five percent decline, prompting government intervention to address market instability.

clusters.headline: Seoul Shares See Minor Rebound Following Steep AI Market Decline
aiSummaryBullets: The Korea Composite Stock Price Index rose by 0.29 percent to finish at 4,711.21 points on Thursday.
The minor market rebound follows a substantial six percent retreat recorded in the previous trading session.

clusters.headline: Justice Minister Nominee Lee Yong-cheol Discusses System Reforms
aiSummaryBullets: Justice Minister nominee Lee Yong-cheol pledged to finalize ongoing reforms within the nation's criminal justice system.
The nominee stated that investigative independence must remain aligned with public expectations and accountability.

clusters.headline: Unionized rail workers launch work-to-rule campaign; service disruptions likely
aiSummaryBullets: The Korea Herald reports: Unionized rail workers launch work-to-rule campaign; service disruptions likely
Yonhap reports: Unionized rail workers launch work-to-rule campaign; service disruptions likely

clusters.headline: South Korean Fair Trade Watchdog Fines 15 Firms For Bond Collusion
aiSummaryBullets: Fifteen bond dealers have been penalized 1.6 trillion won for colluding on government bond bidding processes.
The decision was issued by the South Korean Fair Trade Commission following an investigation into market rigging practices.
